summary: Solo backcountry skier caught, buried and killed by a hard-slab avalanche on Red Mountain Number 3 (Bollywood); wife found the debris, got a transceiver signal, and OMRT assisted in removing the victim
location: Red Mountain Number 3 (Bollywood), east of Red Mountain Pass
responding_agency: Ouray Mountain Rescue Team + Ouray County Sheriff, CAIC
notes: Buried ~1m deep for 4+ hours; transceiver + airbag pack armed but undeployed
